license_required.quote: A person, partnership, professional corporation, or limited liability company shall not, without an active certificate of certified public accountant or a valid registration

issuing_authority.quote: "Board" means the state board of accountancy created in section 12-100-104

degree_required.value: Baccalaureate or higher degree with accounting program, plus 150 semester hours
degree_required.quote: Has a baccalaureate or higher degree conferred by an accredited college or university with an accounting program approved by the board

accrediting_body.value: Regional accrediting agencies including Middle States, North Central, New England, Northwest Commission, Southern Association, Western Association
accrediting_body.quote: A college or university that is accredited by one of the following regional accrediting agencies

required.quote: Has one year's experience that: Meets the requirements set by the board by rule

kind.value: accounting, attest, compilation, management advisory, financial advisory, tax, or consulting skills
kind.quote: Is in any type of service or advice involving the use of accounting, attest, compilation, management advisory, financial advisory, tax, or consulting skills, which may be gained through employment in government, industry, academia, or public practice

exams.name: CPA Examination (AICPA)
exams.notes: Board may use AICPA standard examinations; candidates must meet educational requirements before sitting
exams.quote: The board may use the standard examinations and advisory grading service promulgated by the American Institute of Certified Public Accountants

exams.name: Ethics Examination
exams.notes: Course of study and written examination on professional ethics required
exams.quote: Has successfully completed a course of study concerning the subject of professional ethics approved by the board and passed a written examination concerning the subject

interval_years.quote: the board shall not require continuing education of more than eighty hours every two years

required.quote: As a condition of renewing, reactivating, or reinstating a certificate of certified public accountant, every applicant shall comply with continuing education requirements adopted by the board.

hours_per_period.quote: the board shall not require continuing education of more than eighty hours every two years

period_years.quote: the board shall not require continuing education of more than eighty hours every two years

available.quote: The board may issue a certificate of certified public accountant to an applicant who satisfies the requirements of the occupational credential portability program.

requirements.value: Must satisfy the requirements of the occupational credential portability program
requirements.quote: The board may issue a certificate of certified public accountant to an applicant who satisfies the requirements of the occupational credential portability program.

regulatory_model.quote: A person, partnership, professional corporation, or limited liability company shall not, without an active certificate of certified public accountant or a valid registration: As an independent auditor, make or conduct an investigation, examination, or audit

title_protection.quote: a person shall not assume or use the title or designation "certified public accountant", the abbreviation "C.P.A.", or any other title, designation, words, letters, abbreviation, sign, card, or device tending to indicate that the person is a certified public accountant unless the person holds a certificate as a certified public accountant

scope_protection.quote: A person, partnership, professional corporation, or limited liability company shall not, without an active certificate of certified public accountant or a valid registration: As an independent auditor, make or conduct an investigation, examination, or audit of the financial statements or supporting records of any person, organization, or corporation

disciplinary_grounds.description: Fraud or deceit in obtaining or attempting to obtain a CPA certificate or registration
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Fraud or deceit in obtaining or in attempting to obtain a certificate as a certified public accountant or in obtaining registration under this article 100

disciplinary_grounds.description: Fraud or negligence in the practice of public accounting or in filing/failing to file own income tax returns
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Fraud or negligence in the practice of public accounting in Colorado or any other state or in the filing of or failure to file the certified public accountant's own income tax returns

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation of any provision of the article, applicable rules, or valid agency orders
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violation of any provision of this article 100 or an applicable provision of article 20 of this title 12, of any final rule promulgated by the board, or of any valid agency order

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation of a rule of professional conduct promulgated by the board
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violation of a rule of professional conduct promulgated by the board under the authority granted by this article 100

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction of a felony or crime involving dishonesty or fraud
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Conviction of a felony or of a crime, an element of which is dishonesty or fraud, under the laws of any state or of the United States

disciplinary_grounds.description: Discipline taken against the person's authority to practice as a CPA or public accountant in any jurisdiction
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Discipline taken against the person's authority to practice as a certified public accountant or a public accountant in any jurisdiction

disciplinary_grounds.description: Discipline taken against the right to practice before any state or federal agency or PCAOB for improper conduct
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Discipline taken against the person's right to practice before any state or federal agency or agency outside the United States or the public company accounting oversight board

disciplinary_grounds.description: Providing CPA services to the public for a fee or acting as resident manager without an active certificate or valid registration
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Without an active certificate of certified public accountant or a valid registration: Providing certified public accounting services to the public for a fee

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to comply with continuing education requirements prescribed by the board
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to comply with the requirements for continuing education as prescribed by the board

disciplinary_grounds.description: Act or omission that fails to meet generally accepted accounting principles or generally accepted auditing standards
disciplinary_grounds.quote: An act or omission that fails to meet generally accepted accounting principles or generally accepted auditing standards in the profession

disciplinary_grounds.description: Use of false, misleading, or deceptive advertising
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Use of false, misleading, or deceptive advertising

disciplinary_grounds.description: Substance use disorder or excessive use of habit-forming drug, controlled substance, or alcohol that renders the CPA unfit to practice
disciplinary_grounds.quote: A substance use disorder, as defined in section 27-81-102, or an excessive use of a habit-forming drug, controlled substance, as defined in section 18-18-102 (5), or alcohol beverage that renders the certified public accountant unfit to practice public accounting

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to retain records of work performed for each client for a period of five years
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to retain records of the work performed for each client for a period of five years

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure of a partnership, professional corporation, or LLC to register with the board and renew registration
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure of a partnership, professional corporation, or limited liability company to register with the board pursuant to section 12-100-114 and to renew the registration as prescribed by the board

disciplinary_grounds.description: Fraudulent, coercive, or dishonest practices or demonstrated incompetence, untrustworthiness, or financial irresponsibility
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Fraudulent, coercive, or dishonest practices or demonstrated incompetence, untrustworthiness, or financial irresponsibility in Colorado, another state, a United States territory, or a foreign country.

definition_quote.value: No person, partnership, professional corporation, or limited liability company shall issue, author, or publish any opinion or certificate relating to any accounting or financial statement if the opinion or certificate utilizes any title or designation, the use of which is prohibited by law.
definition_quote.quote: No person, partnership, professional corporation, or limited liability company shall issue, author, or publish any opinion or certificate relating to any accounting or financial statement if the opinion or certificate utilizes any title or designation, the use of which is prohibited by law.

methods_authorized.quote: Is in any type of service or advice involving the use of accounting, attest, compilation, management advisory, financial advisory, tax, or consulting skills

attest_services_types.quote: "Peer review" means a study, appraisal, or review by an independent certified public accountant of one or more aspects of the professional work of another certified public accountant or of a registered partnership, corporation, or limited liability company that issues attest or compilation reports.

compilation_services_authorized.quote: the board shall not renew the certificate of a holder who issues attest or compilation reports unless the certificate holder performs public accounting within a partnership, professional corporation, or limited liability company or the certificate holder has undergone a peer review

education_semester_hours_required.quote: Has completed at least one hundred fifty semester hours of college education approved by the board

ethics_exam_required.quote: Has successfully completed a course of study concerning the subject of professional ethics approved by the board and passed a written examination concerning the subject

practice_privilege_no_notice_required.quote: Nothing in this article 100 prohibits a certified public accountant whose principal place of business is located in another state or jurisdiction of the United States from practicing in this state on professional business, as defined by rules promulgated by the board.

value: Subject to jurisdiction and disciplinary authority of the board
Comply with requirements of this subsection and board rules
Cease offering or rendering professional services if certificate/license/registration in home state is no longer valid
Appoint the home-state board as agent for service of process
practice_privilege_consent_conditions.quote: A certified public accountant from another state or jurisdiction of the United States who is practicing in this state pursuant to this subsection (2) and the firm that employs the certified public accountant simultaneously consent, as a condition of practicing in this state

firm_majority_cpa_ownership_required.quote: A simple majority of the ownership of a certified public accounting firm doing business as a public accounting firm in Colorado, in terms of financial interests and voting rights of all partners, officers, shareholders, members, or managers, shall be licensed certified public accountants in good standing

nonlicensee_firm_owners_permitted.quote: Any other partner, shareholder, or member thereof may, but need not, be a certified public accountant of some state, in good standing

peer_review_required_for_firm_renewal.quote: The board shall not renew the registration of a firm that issues attest or compilation reports unless the registered partnership, professional corporation, or limited liability company has undergone a peer review

inactive_license_status_available.quote: The holder of a certificate of certified public accountant, upon notice to the board in any form or manner designated by the board, shall have the holder's name transferred to an inactive list and shall not be required to comply with the continuing education requirements for certificate renewal

retired_license_status_available.quote: Any person who has received from the board and holds a certificate of certified public accountant, including an expired certificate of certified public accountant that remains subject to renewal, reactivation, or reinstatement, may apply to the board for retired status.

out_of_state_firm_no_office_exemption.quote: a foreign partnership, corporation, limited partnership, limited liability limited partnership, or limited liability company may engage in the practice of accountancy in this state without registering with the board if the practice is incident to the entity's regular practice outside this state

office_supervision_by_licensed_cpa_requi.quote: Each resident manager in charge of an office of the partnership, professional corporation, or limited liability company in this state must be a certified public accountant of this state in good standing.

client_confidentiality_privilege.quote: Nothing in this section shall modify the accountant-client privilege specified in section 13-90-107 (1)(f)

working_papers_ownership_by_licensee.quote: All statements, records, schedules, working papers, and memoranda made by a certified public accountant incident to or in the course of professional service to a client by the certified public accountant, except financial statements submitted by a certified public accountant to a client and books and records prepared for the use of the client, shall be and remain the property of the certified public accountant in the absence of an express agreement to the contrary

foreign_accountant_practice_exception.quote: Nothing in this article 100 shall prohibit an accountant who holds a certificate, degree, or license in a foreign country, constituting a recognized qualification for the practice of public accounting in the country, from practicing in this state on professional business incident to his or her regular practice outside this state

single_act_evidence_sufficient.quote: In any legal action brought under this article 100, evidence of the commission of a single act prohibited by this article 100 is sufficient to justify an injunction.

firm_permit_required_for_attest_services.quote: Except as provided in section 12-100-117 (2), a partnership, professional corporation, or limited liability company engaged in this state in the practice of public accounting as certified public accountants shall register with the board

cpa_emeritus_or_retired_status_available.quote: Any person issued a retired status certificate of certified public accountant may be styled and known as a "retired certified public accountant" or "retired C.P.A."
